comments.author: retzkek
comments.story: The Alexander: Why did you build such a long piano?
comments.why: Ray-traced animation of music machines that inspired the commenter's ideas.
comments.text: Inspired, I presume, by those awesome ray-traced animations from the early oughts? I had started sketching ideas on how to make that a reality (pneumatics and magnets mainly) but never got beyond concept. Specifically this one: [VIDEO]

comments.author: bitwize
comments.story: Moritz Simon Geist’s robots make technical techno
comments.why: CG animations of fantastic machines playing music, parameterized by MIDI.
comments.text: See also: The Floppotron: Music played on old floppy drives, hard drives, and scanners. [LINK] Animusic: CG animations of fantastic machines playing music. The animation is parameterized to the MIDI input. Attempts to build real-world working models of these machines or machines like them have been made, with varying levels of success: [VIDEO] Compressorhead: An all-robot heavy metal band. Famous for Stickboy, the band's four-armed, headbanging drummer, or at least Stickboy is what I remember most about the band. [LINK]
